Searching for the best custom football kit supplier? The market is crowded with options like Jersix, Owayo, and Spized. This comparison objectively analyzes MOMUTO against the leading European competitors. No marketing fluff—just the data you need to decide.

FULL COMPARISON TABLE

ANALYSIS BY USE CASE

For Urgent Orders (< 4 Weeks)

Winner: MOMUTO - MOMUTO ships in 25-30 days door to door as standard; for a tight deadline, the optional fast lane (+€59 per order) brings that down to roughly 18-23 days. That’s competitive with Jersix (3-4 weeks) and faster than Owayo or Spized.

For Small Teams (5-a-side / 7-a-side)

Winner: MOMUTO - This is where we shine. Most suppliers penalize small orders with high shipping costs or "sample" pricing. With free shipping starting at €50 and no MOQ, MOMUTO is the most cost-effective choice for small squads.

For Custom Design Capability

Tie: MOMUTO & Jersix - Both brands value unique design. Jersix is known for great creative work. MOMUTO matches this with its free 3D designer plus an optional professional (Bespoke) design service (€15 deposit, credited in full for orders of 5+), whereas Owayo and Spized force you to use automated 3D tools which can limit creativity.

For Material Quality

The Hidden Advantage: Most competitors offer standard 100% Polyester. MOMUTO includes Elastane in our standard fabric blend. This provides a modern, "Pro" fit with better stretch and comfort, usually only found in premium tiers of other brands.

THE VERDICT: WHICH ONE IS FOR YOU?

Choose MOMUTO if:

  • You want reliable delivery (25-30 days, or 18-23 days with the fast lane).
  • You are ordering for a small group or need flexibility.
  • You want premium fabric (Elastane blend) at a standard price.
  • You prefer a human designer to handle the artwork for you.

Choose Jersix if:

  • You specifically require "Made in EU" production.
  • You are already familiar with their sizing/cuts.

Choose Owayo/Spized if:

  • You love spending hours designing yourself on a 3D configurator.
  • Time is not a factor (you have 6+ weeks before the season starts).

Objective Conclusion: For amateur teams, esports orgs, and social leagues looking for the best balance of Speed, Price, and Quality, MOMUTO offers the modern alternative to the traditional European giants.
